helpIntro: Northeastern uses a 4.000 scale weighted by semester hours. Enter your final Northeastern grades and credits to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For the standard undergraduate record. S/U, incomplete, transfer, withdrawal, audit, and other non-GPA marks are excluded. Graduate, School of Law, and College of Professional Studies rules need separate review.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.000 quality points and a 4-credit B+ earns 13.332. Together, 29.332 ÷ 8 = 3.667.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.000 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.667 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.333 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.000 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.667 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.333 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.000 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.667 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.333 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.000 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.667 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.000 points; semester hours remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory on S/U basis; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.X: Incomplete on S/U basis; excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.NG: Grade not reported; temporary and excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.L: Audit; no credit and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.T: Transfer notation; excluded from Northeastern GPA.

specialTypes.name: Northeastern course
specialTypes.note: Enter final Northeastern grade and semester hours.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted external transfer work does not supply a Northeastern grade for institutional GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Use Repeat Impact only for a nonrepeatable course with the same semester hours. The calculator replaces the selected original attempt with the new final grade; repeatable-for-credit courses should be entered as separate completed rows.
